resolvedFindings.problem: Transient query invalidation unmounted the selected decision controls, losing chosen fields and adopting a newer reviewed revision.
resolvedFindings.fix: Keep the selected editor mounted during same-identity loading; discard the retained projection when the replacement result or identity becomes authoritative.
resolvedFindings.regression: Real useIssueQuery invalidation, metadata-only row reset, delayed replacement, chosen fields retained, expectedRevision remains the original reviewed version.

resolvedFindings.problem: A superseded triage decision prevented recovering unrelated queued edits; the available global discard removed every draft.
resolvedFindings.fix: Discard superseded decisions independently, retaining unrelated mixed-batch/tail drafts for explicit version review. Missing bounded-cache rows are checked through the authorized detail endpoint and identity-epoch checks before classification.
regressions: Mixed-batch and separate-tail edits survive discard, reload, explicit rebase and submission.
A metadata-only cache reset with a fetched still-pending issue does not discard the decision.
